content.title: About
content.content: Almond milk is a plant‑based beverage made by blending almonds with water and straining the mixture. The unsweetened version has a mild, slightly nutty flavor and serves as a dairy‑free alternative.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Almond milk first appeared in Europe in the 19th century as a vegetarian alternative to cow’s milk.
Unsweetened almond milk contains roughly 3‑5 times fewer calories than whole cow’s milk.
Unlike soy milk, almond milk is naturally gluten‑free and lactose‑free.
About 150 g of almonds are needed to produce one litre of almond milk.
Almond milk is commonly used in smoothies, oatmeal, sauces, and baked goods.

items.title: Rich in vitamin E
items.content: Vitamin E is a powerful antioxidant that protects cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Low calorie content
items.content: Unsweetened almond milk provides about 30 kcal per 100 ml, making it suitable for calorie‑controlled diets.

items.title: Source of healthy fats
items.content: Almonds contain monounsaturated fatty acids that support heart health.

items.title: Bone support
items.content: While naturally lower in calcium than cow’s milk, many brands fortify almond milk with calcium and vitamin D.

items.title: Lactose and gluten safety
items.content: Suitable for people with lactose intolerance and celiac disease.

items.title: Tree nut allergy
items.content: Individuals allergic to almonds may experience severe reactions when consuming the product.

items.title: Low protein content
items.content: Almond milk provides less protein than cow’s milk, so it may not be a complete substitute for high‑protein needs.

items.title: Additives and sweeteners
items.content: Some commercial versions contain added flavors, stabilizers, or sugars; choose an unsweetened, additive‑free option.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Drink it plain, add to coffee, smoothies, oatmeal, baked goods, sauces, or soups. For a richer texture, blend with a little oil or use a homogenized variety.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated at 1‑4 °C. Once opened, consume within 5‑7 days. Do not leave at room temperature for more than 2 hours to prevent spoilage.
